description: Header file defining classes and methods for writing XML elements, including XmlAttributes and XmlElementWriter, with support for nested elements and attribute handling.

classes.name: XmlAttributes
classes.description: A vector of XML attribute key-value pairs with methods to add attributes.

classes.name: XmlElementWriter
classes.description: Helper class for writing XML elements with support for nested elements and formatting.

methods.name: XmlAttributes(std::string_view attr_key, std::string_view attr_value)
methods.description: Constructor to initialize XmlAttributes with a single key-value pair.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Method to add an attribute key-value pair to XmlAttributes.

methods.name: XmlElementWriter(std::ostream& out, const std::string& tag, const XmlAttributes& attributes)
methods.description: Constructor for creating an XML element with no indentation (root element).

methods.name: XmlElementWriter(std::ostream& out, const std::string& tag, const XmlAttributes& attributes, int indent)
methods.description: Constructor for creating an XML element with specified indentation.

methods.name: XmlElementWriter(std::ostream& out, const std::string& tag, const std::string& attribute_name, const Writer& attribute_value_writer, int indent)
methods.description: Template constructor for creating an XML element with a single attribute without copying attribute value.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Method to write arbitrary XML element text content.

methods.name: SubElement
methods.description: Methods to start new sub-elements, supporting nested elements with optional attributes.

methods.name: StartContent
methods.description: Method to finish opening tag and start writing content or sub-elements.
